Первый экран можно нарисовать за день. П: You can design a first screen in a day. Working out what it needs to say can take longer. Yet that question determines whether the result is simply a beautiful mockup or a useful tool.
Что человек должен понять или сделать по: What should someone understand or do after visiting the website? "Learn about the company" is too broad. A more useful goal is specific: understand a service, compare approaches, explore relevant work or start a conversation.
Дайте контекст, а не список пожеланий: Give context, not just a wishlist
Чтобы принять дизайнерское решение, нужн: Good design decisions need an audience, a situation and a set of constraints. The more specific the brief, the fewer arbitrary choices end up in the design. Decisions become easier to explain and discussions more productive.
Хороший дизайн начинается не с пустого х: Good design starts with a precise question, not a blank canvas.
Страница редко может одинаково хорошо ра: A page can rarely tell every story equally well at once. Find the main message, then check whether each section supports it. Sometimes the best way to strengthen a page is to remove what is competing for attention.
Проверяйте смысл до оформления: Check the meaning before the styling
Соберите текстовый каркас страницы и про: Build a text outline and read it from start to finish. Is the offer clear? Does it answer the next natural question? Only then move on to colours, type and images. This gives the visual idea a solid foundation.

Движение легко делает сайт заметнее. Тру: Motion can easily make a website more noticeable. Making it more useful at the same time is harder. Every animation needs a clear role.
Плавное раскрытие меню помогает увидеть,: A smoothly opening menu helps people understand where the new state came from. A short transition between related elements preserves context. The effect explains the interface rather than merely decorating it.
При наведении кнопка может немного измен: A button may change colour on hover, or a card's image may move slightly closer. This confirms that it is interactive. The movement should be brief enough not to delay the action or make anyone wait for the effect to finish.
Движение полезно, когда после него интер: Motion earns its place when it leaves the interface clearer than before.
Автоматическое движение не должно перекр: Automatic movement should not cover text, hijack scrolling or interrupt reading. Respect the system's reduced-motion preference. The page's meaning and accessibility should survive with animation completely disabled.
Проверить на настоящем экране: Test it on a real screen
То, что хорошо выглядит в дизайнерском м: What looks good in a design mockup can become tiring on a phone. Test animation alongside everyday navigation, keyboard use and long-form reading. If the effect gets in the way, simplify it.

Небольшому бизнесу не всегда нужна сложн: A small business does not always need a complex component library. But clear principles help from the start: they save time and make every new touchpoint recognisable.
Начните с пары шрифтов, ограниченной пал: Start with a pair of typefaces, a limited palette and a composition principle. The number of options matters less than knowing when to use each one. Short examples are more useful than a long list of abstract restrictions.
Карточка услуги, обложка статьи, экран к: A service card, an article cover, a contact page and a social post are different formats for the same story. Show which elements stay consistent and what can change to suit the task.
Последовательность — это не одинаковость: Consistency is not sameness. It is a recognisable logic behind your decisions.
Система не должна превращаться в набор ж: A system should not become a rigid set of rules. Separate core principles from temporary techniques. A new service or campaign can then expand the visual language while keeping its identity intact.
Сохраните исходники в понятной структуре: Organise the source files clearly, name them well and add a short guide. A system only starts working when the team can use it without the creator's constant involvement.
